title: Benchmark version metadata
description: Machine-checkable schema for a per-version _metadata.json: benchmark-level facts and the section/heading hierarchy that don't belong on any individual rule. Generated by tools/generate_metadata.py - never hand-author or hand-edit; regenerate after the source markdown changes.

release_date.description: DD-MM-YYYY. Null when the source document doesn't state a release date in a format this repo's tooling can parse.

id.description: The heading's numeric ID exactly as it appears in the source, e.g. "4", "4.1", "4.11.49".

description.description: Verbatim boilerplate sentence following the heading in the source (e.g. "This section contains recommendations for X."), or null when the source has no such sentence for this section. Never synthesized from the title.
